posts.title: AI Brief — Thursday, 5 November 2026
posts.summary: Open-weights day — Moonshot dropped the Kimi K3.1 Pro weights (2.8T MoE, 1M context), Ricursive's dense Ripple-65B claims the US open-weight lead on agentic coding and Tencent shipped Hy4 with weights promised "in the coming days", while Anthropic showed you can cryptographically prove which model produced an answer.
